opening: I have a watery discharge running from my left nostril.
The discharge and the headaches have been going on for three months.

I was given anti-allergy medicine for it.

opening.text: I have a watery discharge running from my left nostril, and I've been having dull, throbbing headaches. The discharge and the headaches have been going on for three months. I was diagnosed with allergic rhinitis by another doctor and was given anti-allergy medicine for it, and I also had an episode of sinusitis five years ago.
